beneficiary: A local service where actual past help and a current named witness demonstration govern finite output, without making memories universal or permanent opportunities.
source: RM_FLAGS_EVENTS_RUNTIME.rb plus actual MEMORY_FLAGS/RECENT_EVENTS definitions; DEV/DIST variants must be verified.
acceptance: Known scoped flags and recent events match an independent Python model for declared source cases; strict expiry uses exp>turn.
Exact local witness queries cannot use global/null event wildcard or another subject; preserve permissive source query separately rather than silently normalizing it.
Actual helping consumes one part and action turn; sets persistent observed history plus current relation support and recent witness after the cost.
Actual service checks exact local facts and one coin before advancing one action turn, then records one real fitting per bench.
Expired opportunity cannot erase actual help or delivered fitting. Declining clears only current support/event; actual re-demonstration costs a part/action and explicitly restores support.
Reads/time/redraw and refused/forged requests cannot progress clocks, spend resources or create fitting.
Browser fidelity rejects an isolated wrong-recipient/expired-opportunity renderer.

parameters.decline_cost: no action turn; clear current relation support/recent event only

limits: Original experimental two-bench staging, not imported lore or approved final canon.
Source model/parity are not Ruby/RGSS/RMXP execution. Full source stores/persistence/catalog policies not recovered by typed subset.
Strict known identity/named-context policy differs from unsafe unknown/global/missingNPC fallback; separate explicit source wildcard semantics remain testable.
Software controls overlap outcomes; no participants, independent population studies, human experience, Unity/Windows/Steam or commercial clearance.

alternatives.quest_progress: Actual target1 no-op already statically recorded; real ordered original chain would require mostly new policy.
alternatives.passives: Current UI merely displays/assigns; prose effects and one-slot enforcement do not yet supply actual effect engine.
alternatives.unity_and_human: No licensed Editor/modules or participant/device access established; preserve production obligations.
alternatives.intake_packaging: Working previous consumer offers no new concrete packaging/token dependency.

negative_policy: Preserve meaningful source conflicts, mutant detections, development/instrument failures and superseded results; no gate weakened.
